sentences.text:
In the heart of the Karakum Desert,
a giant *flaming crater* burns day and night.
sentences.spoken: In the heart of the Karakum Desert in Turkmenistan, a giant flaming crater burns like an open portal into the underworld.

sentences.text:
Known as the *Door to Hell*,
this 70m pit has burned non-stop since 1971.
sentences.spoken: Known as the Door to Hell, this fiery pit measures seventy meters across and thirty meters deep, burning incessantly since nineteen seventy-one.

sentences.text:
A Soviet drilling rig punctured a gas cavern,
causing the ground to *violently collapse*.
sentences.spoken: It began when a Soviet drilling rig accidentally punctured a subterranean natural gas cavern, causing the ground to violently collapse.

sentences.text:
The rig fell into the sinkhole,
*unleashing an uncontrollable methane blowout*.
sentences.spoken: The entire drilling rig and camp plunged into the crater, miraculously without loss of life, but exposing a massive methane blowout.

sentences.text:
To stop poisonous fumes, engineers lit the gas,
*expecting it to burn out in weeks*.
sentences.spoken: To prevent toxic methane gas from poisoning nearby villages, engineers ignited the crater, estimating it would burn out in a few weeks.

sentences.text:
Over 50 years later, roaring flames
still erupt from *hundreds of pressurized vents*.
sentences.spoken: Over fifty years later, roaring flames still erupt from hundreds of pressurized vents, fed by vast untapped underground gas reserves.

sentences.text:
Temperatures reach *over 400°C*,
glowing like a beacon across the desert.
sentences.spoken: Temperatures at the bottom reach over four hundred degrees Celsius, visible at night for miles across the pitch black desert dunes.

sentences.text:
In 2013, an explorer rappelled to the floor,
*collecting samples inside the 400°C inferno*.
sentences.spoken: In two thousand thirteen, explorer George Kourounis rappelled to the bottom wearing a heat-reflective suit, collecting soil samples from the inferno.

sentences.text:
Scientists discovered *extremophile bacteria*
living happily inside the burning soil.
sentences.spoken: Astonishingly, scientists discovered rich colonies of extremophile bacteria living happily inside the burning high-temperature soil.
